title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - UUID
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/UUID . A universally unique identifier (UUID) is a 128-bit number used to identify items, also known as a globally unique identifier (GUID); documented in ISO/IEC 11578:1996 and ITU-T Rec. X.667 | ISO/IEC 9834-8:2005. Subclass of s4inma:ID per the SAREF4INMA ontology; the generic hasIDValue property is inherited from ID and documented there (this class uses the equivalent, more specific hasUUIDValue property instead, which is declared in the ontology as a sub-property of hasIDValue).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'UUID'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasUUIDValue.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/hasUUIDValue'. The value of the UUID in its canonical 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal textual representation.
